corrections.why: firelookout.com says the lookout burned in the 1934 Pete King Fire, and idahofirelookouts.com says Burned in Wildfire. The 1981 history uses destroyed by fire, so the event is recorded as burned with that note.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A separate Split Creek Point Lookout in the Payette National Forest (NHLR US 1455, built 1933, tower disassembled 2008, cab in a McCall museum, elevation 6628 ft) is a different tower. Its record is us-id-split-creek-point-2. This story covers only the 1931 Clearwater tower that burned in 1934, and it should not be merged with that record.

notes_for_editor: Four sources agree on the 1931 build and the 1934 loss to the Pete King Fire. The brief's record is missing a built event and recorded the loss as destroyed, so both are fixed here. Records us-id-split-creek-point-2 and the Cent. ID Hist. Museum cab entry describe the Payette NF lookout, which is a different tower; the museum cab should not be attached to this record. The 9.1 m height is the 30-foot figure converted. No source describes the site today and no access level is supported. The 1981 Hartig history is a local secondary source and gives no staffing names, so staffing is left out.
